question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To show a clean pair of heels
solution:
The correct answer is "To run fast."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"to show a clean pair of heels"** means to run away or flee from a situation quickly, often with agility or speed, in order to escape or avoid trouble or confrontation. (मुसीबत या टकराव से बचने या बचने के लिए किसी स्थिति से जल्दी से भागना या भागना, अक्सर चपलता या गति के साथ)
 
• It implies a swift departure, leaving behind pursuers or adversaries.
 
 
• **Example**:* After realizing the police were closing in, the suspect **showed a clean pair of heels**__ and disappeared into the crowded streets.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4**.
